_why: The downmix badge is the only COMPOSED label on this page and it renders ONLY when getDownmixStatus() reports an active fold-down. The generic stub's default for that name is the STRING '{}', on which `status.active` is undefined, so the badge stays hidden and ui.downmix would be a key the geometry gate never measures. This supplies the shape PluginEditor.cpp really completes with (an object carrying active/sourceChannels/targetChannels), so the badge renders and both languages are measured.
